name: Seth
description: Man living at the time before the Flood

points: Seth was appointed another seed instead of Abel. Through Seth men began to call upon the name of the Lord; they started to worship the Most High and keep the commandments, while the line of Cain went on in evil and wickedness. That is why the Most High chose the line of Seth.

note.label: Genesis 4: Cain, Abel, and the Sons of the Wicked

points: Seth replaced Abel and became the chosen line. Then began men to call upon the name of the Lord: because this was the lineage of the sons of God.

note.label: Popular Persuasions: Fighting Against Heaven Defending Earth

points: Notice Seth was in Adam's likeness, after Adam's image. It did not say that about Cain; it said Cain was of that wicked one. Cain was in the image of Satan, not in the image of Adam.

He shall smite the corners of Moab, and destroy all the children of Sheth: anybody that worships the Egyptian god Seth. And Edom shall be a possession: Edom shall become servants to this people, and Israel shall do valiantly.

And shall smite the corners of Moab, and destroy all the children of Sheth. Balaam is prophesying of the latter days: this teaching identifies Moab with the Chinese and Ammon with the Japanese, and Sheth goes into the Egyptian. Asia is partaker of the hope of Babylon, going through the earth buying up land, trying to become financially what America already is and to deal with all nations as she has.

note.label: Numbers 24: A Star out of Jacob and the Latter Days

points: Adam was called the son of God, and in his lineage through Seth were also the sons of God, not Cain.
